description: This file defines the Image_Graph_Plotarea class, a component for rendering plot areas with axes and elements in a PEAR PHP graphing utility. It manages axes, plot elements, coordinate calculations, and rendering of the plot area.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea
classes.description: A class for managing and rendering a plot area with axes and plot elements in a PEAR PHP graphing utility.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea
methods.description: Constructor that initializes axes and plot area orientation.

methods.name: _setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent object for the plot area and its axes.

methods.name: setPlotBorderStyle
methods.description: Deprecated method to set border style of the plot area.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a plot element to the plot area, associating it with an axis.

methods.name: _plotWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the plot area excluding padding and axes.

methods.name: _plotHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the plot area excluding padding and axes.

methods.name: _setExtrema
methods.description: Sets the minimum and maximum extents of axes based on plot data.

methods.name: _fillLeft
methods.description: Returns the left boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillTop
methods.description: Returns the top boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillRight
methods.description: Returns the right boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillBottom
methods.description: Returns the bottom boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _axisPointX
methods.description: Converts a data value to an X pixel position using the X axis.

methods.name: _axisPointY
methods.description: Converts a data value to a Y pixel position using the Y axis.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Gets the pixel position for a data value along the X axis, considering orientation.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Gets the pixel position for a data value along the Y axis, considering orientation.

methods.name: _getMinimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of a specified axis.

methods.name: _getMaximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of a specified axis.

methods.name: _labelDistance
methods.description: Returns the label distance for a specified axis.

methods.name: hideAxis
methods.description: Hides specified axes.

methods.name: clearAxis
methods.description: Removes all axes from the plot area.

methods.name: getAxis
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to a specified axis.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Recalculates the coordinates of axes and plot boundaries based on data and layout.

methods.name: setAxisPadding
methods.description: Sets padding inside the plot area for axes.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the plot area and its axes to the canvas.
